headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 5, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies secured a crucial win over the San Diego Padres 6-4, with Zack Wheeler pitching a strong 7.0 innings and striking out 8. Jackson Merrill led the Padres' offense with a home run and two RBIs. In other action, the Baltimore Orioles took down the Boston Red Sox 8-2, with Willson Contreras hitting a home run and collecting 2 hits. The New York Yankees edged out the Cleveland Guardians 2-1, with Brent Headrick earning the win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including DL Hall of the Milwaukee Brewers, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left pectoral strain. The St. Louis Cardinals have also placed Ryan Fernandez on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 3, 2026, due to low back pain. The Boston Red Sox have transferred Garrett Crochet to the 60-day injured list with left shoulder inflammation.

The Boston Red Sox bolstered their rotation with the addition of left-handed pitcher Joe La Sorsa, acquired in a trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Milwaukee Brewers also made a roster move, placing DL Hall on the 15-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Red Sox 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured an 8-2 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Trevor Rogers earning the win. Willson Contreras led the Orioles' offense, hitting a home run (12) and collecting 2 hits.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Guardians in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Cleveland Guardians 2-1 in a closely contested game. Brent Headrick earned the win for the Yankees, while David Bednar secured the save.

top_news.title: **Giants Take Down Brewers in Thrilling 12-9 Victory**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants outlasted the Milwaukee Brewers in a high-scoring matchup, winning 12-9. Jackson Chourio led the Brewers' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Brewers Place DL Hall on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have placed left-handed pitcher DL Hall on the 15-day injured list due to a left pectoral strain.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Bolster Rotation with La Sorsa Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox have strengthened their pitching staff with the addition of left-handed pitcher Joe La Sorsa, acquired in a trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates.
